meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.

examples.text: こちらとしては適切だったと認識しています。
examples.trans: From our standpoint, we conducted the shoot completely appropriately.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.

examples.text: こちらとしては適切だったと認識しています。
examples.trans: From our standpoint, we conducted the shoot completely appropriately.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Limits the preceding noun or phrase to that item alone.

examples.text: これだけお願いします。

meanings.en: whichever (after question word); or something like
meanings.note: After どれ (どれでも) means 'any one at all'; after a noun (店でも) suggests an example ('a shop or something').

examples.text: いつでも来てください。
お茶でも飲みませんか。
examples.trans: Won't you have tea or something?

examples.text: 許せない！想像しただけでも胸が張り裂けそうです。
examples.trans: Unforgivable! Just imagining my daughter on that tape feels like it will tear my heart apart!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

examples.text: 許せない！想像しただけでも胸が張り裂けそうです。
examples.trans: Unforgivable! Just imagining my daughter on that tape feels like it will tear my heart apart!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Directly modifies a noun near the speaker (この店, この辺, この部分).

examples.text: この本は人気があります。

meanings.note: Used for someone's emotional state or sentiment.
分かってる asks or states ongoing understanding; plain past 分かった means 'got it! / I understand'.

examples.text: 日本語が少し分かります。

examples.trans: Got it, I will come right away.

そんな.gloss: such; that kind of; that much

meanings.note: Before たくさん, means 'that huge an amount'.

examples.text: そんな話は知りません。
examples.trans: I do not know such a story.

examples.text: そんな高いものは買えません。
examples.trans: I cannot buy something that expensive.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').

examples.text: 笛の音で想像する分、効果的だよ。規制委員会の規定にもクリアしてる。
examples.trans: Because the whistle sparks the imagination, the thick mosaic actually works—and clears every rule!

examples.text: そんなことより、次の作品どうなってんだ？まだ規制委員会とモメてんのか？
examples.trans: More importantly, how's your next release coming? Still feuding with the regulation commission?

examples.text: そんなバカな…そもそも我々は規制委員会に加盟していない！
examples.trans: That's absurd — we aren't even members of your regulation commission in the first place!

examples.text: 従わない場合、当委員会へ加盟できなくなりますが。
examples.trans: If you refuse to comply, you will be barred from joining this commission.

examples.text: ただ、ほとんどの業者が加盟しているのも事実です。
examples.trans: Still, it is a hard fact that nearly every distributor has joined them.

examples.text: そんなバカな…そもそも我々は規制委員会に加盟していない！
examples.trans: That's absurd — we aren't even members of your regulation commission in the first place!

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).
Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.

meanings.en: justification (申し訳ございません = no excuse / deeply sorry)
meanings.note: Paired with ございません or ありません for formal apologies.

examples.text: 遅れて申し訳ございません。
examples.trans: I am deeply sorry for being late.

examples.text: 大変申し訳ありませんでした。

meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。

meanings.note: Ichidan verb; potential form 決められる means 'can decide'.

examples.text: まだ何も決めていません。
今決められないなら、後で考えましょう。
examples.trans: If you can't decide now, let's think about it later.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Follows a verb's て-form or polite お + stem (お待ちください, お持ち帰りください) to make a polite request.

examples.text: ここに書いてください。

meanings.note: Refers to the upcoming occasion or a recent/current occasion.

examples.text: 今度一緒に食事しましょう。
examples.trans: Let's have a meal together next time.

examples.text: 今度の休みはどこへ行きますか。
examples.trans: Where are you going on your next day off?

meanings.note: Filler or polite attention-getter.

examples.text: あの、ちょっとよろしいですか。
examples.trans: Excuse me, do you have a moment?

examples.text: あの、実は相談があります。
examples.trans: Um, actually I have something to ask you.

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
Blunt or rowdy second-person pronoun used with subordinates, rivals, or close crew.

examples.trans: I leave it to you guys.

meanings.note: Attaches to pronouns or people nouns (僕ら, 彼ら).

examples.text: 従わない場合、当委員会へ加盟できなくなりますが。
examples.trans: If you refuse to comply, you will be barred from joining this commission.

examples.text: お前らに従ったわけじゃないからな、勘違いすんなよ。
examples.trans: And don't flatter yourselves — I didn't do this to obey your committee.

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.
Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

examples.text: お前らに従ったわけじゃないからな、勘違いすんなよ。
examples.trans: And don't flatter yourselves — I didn't do this to obey your committee.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 規制委員会が本腰を入れたってことですよ。目の敵にされてるみたいだな。
examples.trans: The commission has come after us in earnest; they've made us public enemy number one.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Godan verb: potential polite 入れます (はいれます) means 'can enter'.

examples.text: 予約なしでも入れますか。
examples.trans: Can we get in without a reservation?

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Attaches to the irrealis (a-stem) of godan verbs.

examples.trans: I was called by the teacher.

meanings.note: Auxiliary na-adjective expressing resemblance or conjecture.

examples.trans: It looks like it's going to rain.

examples.text: 彼は忙しいみたいですね。

meanings.en: from now on; in the future; now
meanings.note: Time expression referring to the immediate or upcoming future.

examples.text: これから家へ帰ります。

examples.trans: The real test starts from here.

examples.text: 一円も稼いでねえじゃねえかよ！本気でやってんのかよ！
examples.trans: You haven't earned a single yen! Are you even trying seriously!

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

examples.text: これから先は、一円の売り上げも入らなくなる。
examples.trans: From this point forward, not a single yen of sales revenue will come in.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.en: nothing more than (after past verb); up to
meanings.note: After a plain verb + です (出店したまでです), modestly states 'we simply did that and nothing more'.

examples.text: 念のため聞いたまでです。
examples.trans: I merely asked just in case.

meanings.note: Irregular verb: くる -> きます -> きました.
Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).
Ichidan verb.

examples.text: もう少しよく考えてみます。
examples.trans: I'll think about it a little more carefully.

meanings.note: Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。

meanings.note: Everyday reading あした; pairs with また in また明日 ('see you tomorrow').
